name: mkbuilds
description: Claude Code mods by MK Builds, including the ones NotchNerd works with

plugins.name: notchnerd
plugins.description: Lets Claude read and add to the NotchNerd notepad, gives you /notch to jot a line into it, and lets you reply to sessions from the notch.

plugins.name: prayer-times
plugins.description: The next prayer time under Claude Code's prompt, a gentle reminder at adhan, and a pane with today's sky, the timetable, a prayer tracker and the Qibla. Calculated on your machine.
